detailed_descriptions.en: The evening does not have to end with the credits. Build a leisure district around your cinema with nine entertainment and dining businesses, plus a paid parking garage. Choose when to invest in the pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage or event hall. Construction and upgrades take time. Each business can add revenue, but it also brings ongoing costs. Timing matters: a measured expansion can pay off, while investing too quickly can put pressure on your cinema's finances. The leisure district adds a second investment challenge to your cinema business. Plan your next move, keep an eye on income and costs, and discover which businesses suit your cinema. Note: Requires Popcorn & Premieren. Economic results depend on demand and player decisions; profit is not guaranteed.
